headline: Exchange Outflow Narrows To 794.2 Million Dollars From 1045.2 Million
narrative: Clean-asset outflow across 79 exchanges narrowed to 794.2 million dollars from 1045.2 million dollars, equal to 0.2945 percent of the 269.7 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 752.9 million dollars, Crypto.com sent out 43.0 million dollars, and Bybit sent out 24.9 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 25.7 million dollars.
author: jordan
